cases.name: scratch
cases.dockerfile:
FROM scratch
STOPSIGNAL sigusr1
HEALTHCHECK --interval=1h2m3.004s --timeout=1.5ms --start-period=5s --start-interval=2s --retries=3 CMD echo $X || exit 1

cases.name: inherit
cases.dockerfile:
FROM scratch AS base
USER missing
STOPSIGNAL SIGQUIT
HEALTHCHECK --timeout=9s CMD ["missing", "$X"]
FROM base
LABEL child=yes

cases.name: reset
cases.dockerfile:
FROM scratch AS base
STOPSIGNAL SIGQUIT
HEALTHCHECK --timeout=9s --retries=9 CMD old
FROM base
STOPSIGNAL +15
HEALTHCHECK CMD ["new", "$X"]

cases.name: none
cases.dockerfile:
FROM scratch AS base
HEALTHCHECK --timeout=9s CMD old
FROM base
HEALTHCHECK NONE

cases.name: reenable
cases.dockerfile:
FROM scratch
HEALTHCHECK NONE
HEALTHCHECK CMD new

cases.name: shell
cases.dockerfile:
FROM scratch
SHELL ["/custom", "-c"]
ENV X=value
HEALTHCHECK CMD echo "$X"
SHELL ["/later", "-c"]

cases.name: expansion
cases.dockerfile:
FROM scratch
ARG S=SIGUSR1
STOPSIGNAL "$S"
ENV S=SIGUSR2
STOPSIGNAL ${S}

cases.name: max
cases.dockerfile:
FROM scratch
STOPSIGNAL 9223372036854775807
HEALTHCHECK --interval=9223372036854775807ns --retries=2147483647 CMD true
